headline: 20k Subscribers, 9% at Risk – PKR 547.5K on the Line
paragraphs: We have 20,000 paying subscribers this week and about 1,835 of them (9% of the base) are expected to cancel in the next 30 days, putting PKR 547,507 of monthly revenue at risk[F1, F2, F3].

The high‑risk group comprises the top 2,000 subscribers (top 10%) and represents PKR 187,604 of revenue at risk; the main signals are watching much less than last week (61%), failed renewals (54%), being on a Daily pack (41%), sports series ending (39%) and inactivity for 5+ days (39%)[F4, F5, F6, F7, F8, F9].

The riskiest plan is the Daily pack with an average churn risk of 12% and PKR 206,377 at risk, the riskiest payment channel is Operator 4 with 10% risk and PKR 62,465 at risk, and the riskiest genre is Sports with 10% risk and PKR 287,883 at risk; contacting the top 10% by score yields about 28% real leavers, 3.01 × better than random outreach[F10, F11, F12, F13].
actions: Contact the top‑scoring 10% of subscribers this week to intervene early, leveraging the 3.01 × higher success rate over random outreach[F13].
Send targeted retention offers to Daily‑pack users, since they represent the riskiest plan with PKR 206,377 at risk[F7, F10].
Promote fresh sports content and reminders to users flagged for sports‑series‑ended reasons, addressing the riskiest genre that threatens PKR 287,883 of revenue[F8, F12].
